content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Main Pop Updates's PostMain Pop Updates Verified account3d · Shared with PublicIndustry experts weigh in on why female Coachella headliners are often paid less than their male counterparts.While Sabrina Carpenter and Karol G are currently dominating the 2026 Coachella stages, a deeper look into festival economics reveals a persistent gender pay gap. Reports suggest that even top-tier female headliners often secure deals totaling around $8 million, while major male stars like Justin Bieber reportedly command upwards of $10 million for the same two-weekend commitment.Experts point to "legacy status" and historical streaming data as the main culprits, with festival organizers often prioritizing long-standing male icons for the highest pay brackets.
